description: This file defines the SensorSnifferCentral class which manages listeners for analog chart data updates received from the engine state via LinkManager. It allows adding listeners that will be notified when new analog chart data arrives.

classes.name: SensorSnifferCentral
classes.description: A utility class that manages a list of listeners for analog chart data updates. It registers a callback with EngineState to forward data to registered listeners.

classes.name: SensorSnifferCentral.AnalogChartListener
classes.description: An interface defining a callback method onAnalogChart to handle new analog chart data.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds an AnalogChartListener to the list of listeners that will receive analog chart data updates.
